headline: Reggio Emilia Manufacturing Still Growing in Q2 2026, but Momentum Comes Only from Exports and Expectations Turn Negative Again
summary: A Confindustria Reggio Emilia survey shows manufacturing still growing in the second quarter of 2026, with a +3.2% trend in industrial production year on year, driven by exports while expectations turned negative.
why: Local manufacturing surveys offer early signals on Italian industrial output and export demand.
